coordinateSystem.originDescription: Blender world origin = centre of the start line on the ground (X 0, Y 0, Z 0), as in docs/BLENDER_PIPELINE.md §4 and docs/STAGE_01_SPEC.md. Positions are object origins; box volumes (collision, triggers, boundaries) have their origin at the bottom centre. Rotations are Euler XYZ. A marker's forward direction is its local -Y axis. The runtime (glTF, server, web client) uses Y-up game coordinates: game = (x, z, -y).
coordinateSystem.forwardAxis: +Y: the course runs from the start line (Y 0) to the finish line (Y 160)

triggerZones.notes: Finish trigger (spec L4: Y 160 to 163, full width, 3 m high). Entering it finishes the player; the server records the time. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_FinishTrigger.

Safe zone beyond the finish (spec L5: Y 163 to 172). Counts as finished and immune (spec D5); role 'finish' because the schema has only start and finish roles. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_SafeZone.
Approved start zone (spec L2: Y -15 to 0, full width, 3 m high). Players wait here before GO; leaving through its +Y face (Y = 0) is crossing the start line. New in Prompt 04.

movementBoundaries.notes: Start wall at Y -15 behind the spawn rows (spec L6), solid. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_Wall_S.
Back wall at Y 172 beyond the safe zone (spec L6), solid. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_Wall_N.
West fence wall at X -30 (spec L6), 3 m high, solid for players. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_Wall_W.
The fenced yard (X -30 to 30, Y -15 to 172). Not a collider: positions outside it are out of bounds. Same extents as the greybox GMK_BOUNDS marker. Greybox / runtime ID: GMK_BOUNDS.
East fence wall at X +30 (spec L6), 3 m high, solid for players. The service gates sit in this line and stay closed. Greybox / runtime ID: COL_STG01_Wall_E.

watcherDetectionReference.notes: Presentation coverage only (design spec §5): a flat ±55° sector from The Shepherd's position facing the players (-Y), reach 203 m so it covers every yard corner; the head is at Z 28.08 m (WATCHER_HEAD_ANCHOR). coverageDimensions are the sector's bounds (width, depth, 0). Server detection is the authority and is not line-of-sight: every active player in the yard outside the finish and safe volumes is checked during RED (decision E9, spec §4). No detection logic lives in Blender.

notes: All IDs equal Blender object names. Positions are world-space object origins in metres; box volumes have their origin at the bottom centre. Rotations are Euler XYZ in degrees.
The runtime still loads blender/exports/STG01/STG01_collision.json and STG01_markers.json (built from STAGE_01_GREYBOX.blend); check runtime_consistency proves those agree with this metadata.
TRIGGER_START_LINE is new: the approved start zone volume (spec L2). Crossing its +Y face is the start line.
TRIGGER_SAFE_ZONE uses role 'finish' (the schema allows only start and finish); it counts as finished (spec D5).
SIGNAL_RED_ANCHOR and SIGNAL_GREEN_ANCHOR share the lantern centre because one lantern shows every colour.
WATCHER_DETECTION_REFERENCE is the ±55° presentation sector; server detection is not line-of-sight (E9).
Outside-yard proxies (towers, benches, gantry, booth, relics, outer barrier) never meet contestants; they are for walk-offs, spectators and the camera.
